status: Evaluated on 20 frozen topics; classifier-based comparison, no human quality validation
purpose: Test an explicit prose specification addressing the ten most frequent classifier-labelled patterns, with the previously requested restriction on generic engagement closings.

design_choices.positive_specification: State the desired opening, development, ending, source use and paragraph flow alongside explicit exclusions.
design_choices.boundaries: Separate task, reference material, constraints and final output requirements with named delimiters.
design_choices.fidelity: Preserve attribution, numbers and qualifications; distinguish reported facts from claims and inferences. Factual negation remains allowed.
design_choices.structure: No mandatory word count, paragraph count, sentence length or closing template. A short sentence is permitted when useful.
design_choices.examples: Use short construction examples only. Do not supply a complete exemplar post in this initial candidate.
design_choices.review: Request a final check against observable requirements and return the post alone, without requesting visible reasoning.
design_choices.shared_condition: Use the same initial-user-message template for all four writers; retain the existing neutral base instruction and CLI configuration.

sources.use: Clear instructions, explicit output expectations, delimited sections and evaluation of prompt behavior.
Direct instructions, specific success criteria, zero-shot first and no request for visible chain-of-thought.
Explicit prose and formatting preferences. Guidance concerns GPT-6 Astra and is a starting point, not validation for these four writers.

proposed_evaluation.inputs: The same frozen 20 articles and four writers as the baseline; five posts per article/writer.
proposed_evaluation.conversations: New conversations for this condition, separate from baseline. Resume within condition for turns two through five.
proposed_evaluation.settings: Keep writer effort high and existing tools/search isolation unchanged. Enforce runtime settings in the CLIs, not through prose claims in the prompt.
proposed_evaluation.classification: Use the unchanged Decisions API model, definitions, regions and thresholds. Withhold writer identity and prompt condition from the classifier.
proposed_evaluation.comparison: Paired article-level changes in model-labelled incidence, all 40 patterns, threshold sensitivity, post length, source attribution and readability. Literal formatting compliance is descriptive, not proof of quality improvement.
proposed_evaluation.limitations: Targets were selected after baseline results. Any comparison is an exploratory intervention on this source set, and classifier labels have no human gold validation.
